checks.detail: T4 TaskSpec envelope payload_sha256 b1081454cd80d2348bd9238c628f2d55018543f29e27898b95b69efc0416fda7 and task_spec_sha256 d1e0a41ced0ffc11fc7ebf7044a18eb91b10f508d2f8b8cf4802060edd8b7e42 match the committed spec; allowed_files cover final_evaluator.py, the test module and all T4 evidence outputs; baseline and T3-completion evidence references hash-match the live repository files.

TrustedEvaluatorAdapter owns all data-root filesystem access; TrustedEvaluatorDataRoot is a frozen sealed root (existing, non-reparse, resolved once); seal_trusted_data_root rejects missing/file/unsafe roots; TrustedEvaluator itself performs no direct filesystem access.

_validate_child_ref rejects parent traversal, absolute/UNC/device namespaces, ADS, reserved names, trailing dot/space, control bytes and depth > 8; _resolve_blessed_child revalidates lexically, rejects reparse points before and after resolution, and enforces containment via relative_to; the adapter rechecks reparse status immediately before backend open (TOCTOU mitigation); tests cover traversal vectors and a real directory-symlink escape.

HoldoutView.render_for_prompt and EvaluatorResult.render_for_prompt always raise PromptAccessDeniedError; payloads carry only bounded metrics, counts, SHA-256 digests and repo-relative evidence refs; the canary test asserts CANARY_7f3a9c2b, raw file names and filesystem paths never appear in serialized output.

require_open_holdout_lease gates adapter reads; deny_open_holdout_effect rejects non-evaluator paths declaring OPEN_HOLDOUT; require_evaluator_spec_holdout_free fails closed on the runner-facing ExecutionSpec; side-effect values are normalized for both plain strings and SideEffect str-Enum members (B-1 fix with regression tests); a denied lease still consumes the nonce (fail-closed) so no partial result can escape.

HoldoutView and EvaluatorResult enforce 64 metrics, 64 counts, 64 digests, 32 evidence refs and a 256 KiB payload bound; evidence refs must be repo-relative POSIX paths without traversal, backslash, colon or control bytes; FINAL_HOLDOUT taint is mandatory on every view and result.

HoldoutHandle is a distinct frozen slots dataclass wrapping HoldoutConsumed plus HoldoutLease (lease_id, ticket_id, allowed_side_effects, code_sha256) with a derived handle_sha256; the old alias identity test was replaced by the distinct-type contract test.

TrustedEvaluator.evaluate calls AuthorityBroker.consume before any adapter read; SUCCEEDED/FAILED/TIMEOUT/CRASHED all consume permanently; nonce replay and crash-after-consume are rejected; retry requires a genuinely new operator decision (new nonce).

No real data, KBase, Campaign, backtest or Final Holdout bytes were read or written; all fixtures are in-memory or tempdir fakes; the sentinel test proves the real holdout path is never opened; p8_authorized/campaign_authorized/final_holdout_authorized/auto_advance remain false.

advisories.detail: Independent quality review found str-Enum fail-open in deny_open_holdout_effect; fixed with _normalize_effect (value-based normalization) in both the lease and the denial guard, plus four regression tests; re-verified 69/69 focused tests pass.
InMemoryHoldoutStore hardcodes holdout_id/holdout_sha256; documented test-only store, no current bug; a future production HoldoutStore backend must derive these from the request binding.
Reparse escape through a child symlink is tested; the case where the sealed root itself is a symlink is not yet a dedicated test (the code path rejects it). Tracked for T6 matrix verification.

HoldoutLease is constructed inside TrustedEvaluator for the fake-fixtures scope; production integration must validate the lease against the sealed _AuthorityStore (provision, claim, ticket, lease) before granting OPEN_HOLDOUT.
HoldoutView/EvaluatorResult use default dataclass repr; structured metrics could appear in debug logs (not raw holdout bytes); acceptable within scope, custom repr recommended for production.
Evidence-ref regex permits a leading hyphen; informational only, repo-relative refs are under version control.
